'''Robert L. Causey''' is an American philosopher and professor emeritus of Philosophy at the [[University of Texas at Austin]]. Causey is known for his works on [[logic]] and [[philosophy of science]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Narveson |first1=Jan |title=Review of Inequality |journal=Philosophy and Phenomenological Research |date=1996 |volume=56 |issue=2 |pages=482–486 |doi=10.2307/2108539 |jstor=2108539 |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2108539 |issn=0031-8205|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Sklar |first1=Lawrence |title=Robert L. Causey Unity of Science. Dordrecht: Reidel (1977). 185 pp. $34.25. |journal=Philosophy of Science |date=December 1980 |volume=47 |issue=4 |pages=656–657 |doi=10.1086/288968 |language=en |issn=0031-8248}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Blackwell |first1=Richard J. |title="Unity of Science," by Robert L. Causey |website=philpapers.org |date=1978 |url=https://philpapers.org/rec/BLAUOS-2 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bechtel |first1=William |last2=Hamilton |first2=Andrew |title=- Reduction, Integration, and the Unity of Science: Natural, Behavioral, and Social Sciences and the Humanities |journal=General Philosophy of Science |date=1 January 2007 |pages=377–430 |doi=10.1016/b978-044451548-3/50009-4 |publisher=North-Holland}}</ref>

==Books==
* ''Unity of Science'' (Synthese Library Volume 109). D. Reidel Publishing Co., Dordrecht and Boston, 1977.  Now distributed by Springer Verlag
* ''Logic, Sets, and Recursion'', Jones and Bartlett Pub., Boston, 1994, 2nd Edition 2006
